description: Current status of serve's connection to TIA Portal (attached instance, active project). `boundProjectPath` is the project this session is bound to (null when unbound); `bindingDrift` is null, or `{ actual, reason }` when the project open in the bound TIA is no longer that one (reason: project_closed | other_project | project_object_stale): ask the human which project is intended, then tia_connect to rebind. Maps to GET /tia. Read-only (class R).
name: tia_status
title: TIA — connection status
